title: State Street commits to Ireland with lease for new head office in Dublin
summary: State Street commits to Ireland with lease for new head office in Dublin Agreement follows the establishment of global cybersecurity center and new office in Kilkenny Dublin, Ireland, 4th August 2026 State Street Corporation (NYSE: STT), one of the world's leading providers of financial services and investment solutions, is pleased to announce it has signed a multi-year lease, commencing in Q3 2027, for a new office in Dublin, Ireland at 2 Grand Canal Quay (2GCQ). This long-term investment reflects State Streets continued commitment to Ireland and marks an important milestone as it approaches 30 years in the Irish market. State Street first established its Irish operations in 1996 and has grown to become one of the largest international financial services employers in Ireland.
